screening_decisions.reason: Randomised double‑blind placebo‑controlled trial of aminophylline (theophylline analogue) in patients with acute cerebral infarction; treatment started in the acute phase and meets all selection criteria.
Randomised double‑blind placebo‑controlled trial of aminophylline in acute cerebral infarction; treatment administered in the acute period, satisfying inclusion criteria.
Open‑label, single‑arm dose‑escalation study without a randomised control group; does not meet randomised trial requirement.

Randomised cross‑over trial of caffeine, but participants were in the recovery phase (≥ days after stroke); treatment was not started within one week of onset.
